name: Grand Prix de l'automobile Club de France

nar.text: Most drivers changed their two non-slip tires and replaced them with smooth ones since the weather had changed overnight and was now wonderful with dry roads.
The starting order had been decided by ballot. At six in the morning, a canon was fired to announce the start. The cars were sent away at 1-minute intervals.
Most drivers changed their two non-slip tires and replaced them with smooth ones since the weather had changed overnight and was now wonderful with dry roads.
The starting order had been decided by ballot. At six in the morning, a canon was fired to announce the start. The cars were sent away at 1-minute intervals.
Richez in the R3 Renault had taken the corner at Londonières too fast, skidded, and overturned.
Bablot swerves to avoid the overturned Renault, goes down a slope and crashes too; nobody is hurt.
Wagner is fastest on the first lap, seven seconds ahead of Duray; Szisz a minute back.
